services.name: Night Cruise
services.desc: Soflo Tiki welcomes you all to the best night cruise, the perfect way to experience the wonder of Fort Lauderdale when the sun goes down. As you start on your evening journey, get ready to be dazzled by million-dollar mansions lit up in all their glory as we wind along intracoastal waterways. Dance the night away under starlit skies and moonlit seas on our open-air Tiki boat, or relax with a tropical cocktail in hand. With comfy seating and an awesome sound system, our night cruise invites you to soak up Fort Lauderdale’s tropical charm after hours.
